conclusion: Nora Vale (teal coat) took the prototype from the LAB between 18:00 and 18:14. She was seen in the EAST CORRIDOR at 18:10 (V03) and exiting the EAST EXIT at 18:14 carrying the prototype (V04). Her witness statement claiming she 'only visited the east corridor and left' is a misleading partial truth designed to obscure her theft of the item. Other suspects have corroborated alibis or lack of opportunity.
